gamerule.scpArchiveRepeatFiles.descripti: When on, printing a file at the Archive Terminal no longer takes it out of the pool, so any SCP can be printed again and again. Takes priority over per-player files.
gamerule.scpArchivePerPlayer.description: When on, printed files are tracked for each player instead of for the whole world, so every player can print one file of every SCP.
gamerule.scpDossierSpawning.description: When off, opening a sealed file only gives you the readable file for reference, such as for containment signs, and nothing arrives. Files opened earlier also stay quiet until it is turned back on.
config.scp_unleashed.chunk_loader.max_ra: Largest radius a chunk loader may be set to. Radius 0 is just its own chunk, radius r holds a (2r+1) x (2r+1) square.
config.scp_unleashed.chunk_loader.base_p: Flat SP/t every running chunk loader draws.
config.scp_unleashed.chunk_loader.power_: Extra SP/t drawn for every chunk a loader holds.
config.scp_unleashed.chunk_loader.grace_: Seconds a loader keeps its chunks while short of power before letting them go.
config.scp_unleashed.chunk_loader.chunks: How many new chunks one loader may pull in per tick while it spins up. Lower is gentler on the server.
config.scp_unleashed.notice_scale.toolti: Size of the system notices in the top left corner of the screen.
config.scp_unleashed.notice_offset_x.too: Moves the system notices to the right, in GUI pixels.
config.scp_unleashed.notice_offset_y.too: Moves the system notices down, in GUI pixels.
gamerule.scpFactionRaids.description: When on, factions that grow strong enough can raid the places where players live. Raids never happen on Peaceful.
gamerule.scpBlackBookCooldownDays: Z-0001: days before a black book takes ink again
gamerule.scpBlackBookCooldownDays.descri: After a name takes, a black book refuses new ink for this many in-game days. Days turn over at dawn. 0 removes the limit.
gamerule.scpDropAnomalies.description: When on and keepInventory is also on, players who die still drop every anomaly they carry, including sealed cases, occupied stasis pods and culture vials. Everything else stays in their inventory.
config.scp_unleashed.warhead_effects.too: Flashes, screen shake, the red alert overlay, the blast cloud, sirens and blast sounds of the Alpha Warhead. Turn off to skip them for you only. The countdown, announcements and the blast itself are unchanged.
